text: FORM 22 FEE Rs. 200 NOTICE OF ALTERATION OF ADDRESS OR NAME OR AN ADDRESS FOR SERVICE IN THE REGISTER OF DESIGNS. RULE 31 In the matter of Design No. _____________________ Class _____________________________________________ 1Insert (in full) name and I (or We)1____________________________________ address __________________________________________________ hereby request that ___________name, address (or _________ ________________address for service) now upon the Register of Designs may be altered to2 __________________________ 2Insert name or full address. __________________________________________________ __________________________________________________ Address for service in India is: ________________________________________________ ________________________________________________ Dated this____________day of __________________19 3To be signed by the (Signed)3________________________________________ applicant or authorised agent. TO THE CONTROLLER OF DESIGNS, THE PATENT OFFICE, CALCUTTA. -- 1 of 1 --
